title: Semantic Document Reader Convergence Long Loop

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Approved architecture evidence, convergence design, preservation boundary, budgets, and exemplar-first migration order.

allowedWork: Implement only the approved 30-slice x-plus-3 document compiler, reader kernel, equation adapter, isolated exemplar, tests, performance evidence, and review package.

Adapt legacy continuous scroll progress, real KaTeX measurement, perceptual alignment, persistent material owners, static output, and lazy hydration behind current semantic interfaces without editing the legacy repository.
Add narrow architecture seams and compatibility facades required by the exemplar; commit each verified slice independently and record durable Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: Do not port the legacy parser, monolithic runtimes, or page CSS wholesale and do not modify the legacy repository.
Do not generalize styles, clocks, focus behavior, Markdown vocabulary, budgets, or renderer contracts beyond the exemplar before human visual acceptance.
Do not implement FTC, economics, programming, graph, diagram, provider, LLM, or WebGL breadth, and do not redesign the semantic kernel or editor player.
Do not import editor or Three.js code into the learner reader, require JavaScript for reading, update URLs on every scroll frame, or parse HTML or remeasure layout during ordinary animation frames.
goal: Prove one reversible x-plus-3 learner route that combines KP's typed semantic animation kernel with static document delivery, continuous learner-controlled symbolic motion, a lightweight DOM reader adapter, shareable URLs, and accessible semantic focus, then stop for human visual review.
commitCadence: one verified focused commit per completed slice
stopConditions: Stop if the semantic asset requires broad redesign or the new reader cannot consume the current renderer-neutral sampler.
Stop if implementation would modify the legacy repository, require arbitrary trusted HTML, or broaden into a deferred asset family.
Stop if the learner route imports editor or Three.js code, static reading requires JavaScript, or route isolation cannot be enforced.
Stop if ordinary frames require repeated HTML parsing or DOM measurement, or if scroll progress cannot remain deterministic and reversible.
Stop when human visual judgment is required after the s30 review package; do not promote or generalize without new approval.
